Wait. The bind mount! Look at the Dockerfile:
```

    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \

```

It must be from the uv.lock! If the uv.lock still has `source = { directory = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog" }`, then uv would use that path.

But I checked earlier and it showed `source = { directory = "bizlog" }`. Hmm, but that was after a manual test. Let me re-verify the ACTUAL stage files right now, because the orchestrator regenerated stages.
